title: Assessing microplastics, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), and other contaminants of global concern in wadable agricultural streams in Iowa
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article

Shannon M. Meppelink, Dana W. Kolpin, Gregory H. LeFevre, David M. Cwiertny, Carrie E. Givens, Lee Ann Green, Laura E. Hubbard, Luke R. Iwanowicz, Rachael F. Lane, Alyssa L. Mianecki, Padraic S. O'Shea, Clayton D. Raines, John W. Scott, Darrin A. Thompson, Michaelah C. Wilson, James L. Gray
This multi-matrix study of contaminants of global concern (CGCs) in agricultural streams in Iowa (US) is the first to examine multiple CGCs in water, bed sediment, and fish to understand their occurrence in regions of intense agriculture activity.
